concerns.text: FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) lacks a completed implementing task. T035 is marked incomplete (`[ ]`) and is the sole task responsible for generating the required `data/processed/sensitivity_analysis.csv` artifact. Without this task completion, the spec requirement to 'Sweep the optical flow consistency threshold' is unverified.

FR-005 (Statistical Significance) chain is broken. T021-redo (generating `filtered_subset_manifest.json`) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). T031 (ANOVA) depends on T020-redo, which in turn depends on T021-redo. The missing manifest prevents the execution of the statistical analysis required by FR-005.

FR-010 (Motion Labeling) implementation is blocked. T034-extended is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). This task is a hard dependency for T014 (Feasibility Filter) and T033 (Sensitivity Sweep). Without the optical flow magnitude logic, downstream User Story 1 and 3 tasks cannot function.

FR-009 (Benchmark Runner) and FR-003 (Fidelity Metrics) reporting chain is broken. T021-redo is incomplete, which blocks T020-redo (Reporter). T020-redo is required to generate `fidelity_report.json`, which is the input for T031 (ANOVA) and T037 (Full Benchmark). The missing reporter prevents the aggregation of LPIPS/SSIM scores.

FR-007 (Latency Measurement) verification is incomplete. T025-redo (Latency Breakdown) is marked incomplete (`[ ]`). T028-report (Latency Verification Report) depends on T025-redo to include the required breakdown. The missing breakdown prevents full verification of the latency constraint.

Constitution Principle VII (Real-Time Latency Constraint) is not fully covered. While T028-pilot/amend/config/report exist, the specific task to generate the `latency_breakdown.json` (T025-redo) is incomplete, leaving the empirical validation of the 50ms threshold (as per Constitution) partially unverified in the final report artifact.
